QUOTE: Arguments are reduced by `args_to_pattern` (`server_manager.cpp:426`) to the value of the first string-valued argument, or `*` if there is none.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says only the first string argument is used, with `*` when there is none. It never says the other arguments are invisible to matching, and it never says a non-string or unparseable argument collapses to a wildcard.
